csv_project_name: AE for Senior Center Facility Construction Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pasadena, Texas is seeking Architectural and Engineering (A/E) Services to provide design, bid and construction phase, project management services to complete the Senior Center Facility Construction Project. The new proposed Senior Center is planned to be 12,000 to 15,000-sf, it will be constructed on a new site on the south side of Pasadena. The new center will serve as a community gathering place providing recreational, educational, wellness, social, and support services for older adults. The facility is anticipated to include multipurpose meeting spaces with audio and video capabilities, activity rooms
